Remote Work Policy Update

Published: October 15, 2025 · Effective Q4 2025

Effective Q4, all employees must work from the office at least 3 days per week. Hybrid schedules must be approved by your manager. The remote work stipend is reduced to $50/month. The previous flexible-remote option is discontinued.

These changes streamline collaboration and address the utilization concerns raised in the last town hall.
